plan.analysis: Descriptive attribution of already frozen 100-candidate, equal-budget decisions
plan.budget: 100 admitted sentences per 100 held-out claims; maximum five per claim, with separately labelled top-one controls
plan.intervals: Pointwise paired percentile 95% intervals; no family-wide significance claim
plan.resampling: Shared cluster weights for the same query across overlapping partitions; average the four partition differences
plan.conditioning: Frozen fitted scorers, thresholds, selections, admission decisions and observed partitions; no budget reallocation or refitting within resamples
plan.source_sensitivity: FEVER connected components of shared originally annotated Wikipedia pages; no-evidence claims are singleton components because no annotated pages exist. Also diagnose components of all candidate pages; do not issue a source-bootstrap interval with fewer than 20 components or a component containing over 50% of queries.
plan.attribution: Additive changes in correct items and complete claims by minimum annotated-set size and verdict, normalized by all-query counts
plan.selection: No model or rule is selected using these results; every individual scorer is reported
